additional_info.subject: Follow-up on Case 0464873 – 24V AUX Drops to 0V Under Load (Charger Y2 / R2 312900727013)
additional_info.body:
Dear eMobility Support Team,
I hope you are doing well.
I am following up regarding support case
0464873
, related to charger
Y2 / R2 312900727013
, where the
24V AUX output drops from 24V to 0V under load
.
We have been waiting for an update, and the issue is still present on site.
The station is operational but the LED controllers are not functioning due to the AUX voltage collapsing.
We have already tested:
24V supply is stable with no load
As soon as the LED controller is connected, voltage drops to ~0–2V
Tested with a different identical LED driver – same result
Verified wiring and terminals
The issue appears to originate inside the charger’s AUX supply or protection module
Could you please update us on the case status, or advise on the next diagnostic step?
This is an active and important station, and your timely support is highly appreciated.
Thank you very much,
Ahmed Haim
Zen Energy
​
​
​
​
Ahmed Haim
Electrician
*5619
|
ahmedh@zen-ev.com
